user.title: Connect via the EU Data Act portal
user.description: Use your CUPRA ID (My CUPRA app) credentials. First, in a browser at {url}: sign in, accept the consent screen, link your car and create a continuous data request (every 15 minutes). Without that request the portal returns no data. Data is read-only and lags the car by 15 minutes or more.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter password
reauth_confirm.description: The portal rejected the stored password for {username}. If the password is still correct, sign in at {url} once to accept any new terms.

error.consent_required: Sign-in stopped at a terms or consent page. Sign in to the portal in a browser once, accept it and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the portal or finish the login. Check the logs.
error.no_vehicles: No vehicle is linked on the portal. Link your car there first.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to check the portal for new datasets. New data arrives at most every 15 minutes.
data_description.distance_unit: The unit your car's display uses. The portal sends range and odometer in that unit without saying which, so check it against the CUPRA app.
data_description.local_soc_entity: For example an OBD dongle (WiCAN) or wallbox SoC sensor. Adds a 'Battery level (best)' sensor that uses whichever value is fresher.

not_configured.title: No data request for {name}
not_configured.description: The EU Data Act portal has no data request for {name}. Open {url}, select the car and create a continuous data request (every 15 minutes). Sensors stay empty until the first dataset arrives, which can take from 15 minutes to a day.

consent_required.title: EU Data Act portal needs a browser sign-in
consent_required.description: Sign-in stopped at a terms or consent page. Sign in at {url} in a browser, accept the prompt, then reload the integration.
